description: This dataset contains observations of the beetle species Sphenophorus parvulus, collected from various locations in the United States and Canada. The data includes taxonomic information, such as kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species, as well as location data with coordinates and spatial resolution down to the state or province level. Temporal data is also provided, with observations spanning from 2021 to 2025, including day, month, and year of each observation. The dataset can be used for studying the distribution and habitat of Sphenophorus parvulus, as well as for biodiversity research and conservation efforts. The semantic profile of the dataset indicates that it is well-structured for aggregation and classification purposes, with clear identifiers and measurement data. The observations are human-observed and include media such as still images. This dataset can be useful for researchers, conservationists, and enthusiasts interested in beetle species and their ecosystems.
